title: The operating system must authenticate peripherals before establishing a connection.
check_content: Verify the operating system authenticates peripherals before establishing a connection. If it does not, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the operating system to authenticate peripherals before establishing a connection.
VulnDiscussion:
Without authenticating devices, unidentified or unknown devices may be introduced, thereby facilitating malicious activity.

Peripherals include, but are not limited to, such devices as flash drives, external storage, and printers.
